segments.text:
The reprobate may humble himselfe for some sinnes which he hath committed, and may declare this by fasting and teares. When Eliah reprooued Ahab for his Idolatrie, and threatned him from the Lord, it is said, that when he had heard these words,
he rent his cloaths, and put sackcloath vpon him, and fasted, and went softly in token of mourning: and this humiliation stayed Gods wrath for a time.
